name: Experience Booking Skill
description: Enables the AI agent to check availability, manage dates/times, and initiate booking requests for Turkey experiences.

capabilities.logic: Query Merchant_Calendar API for available slots.
Temporarily lock a slot for 15 minutes during the payment process.
Finalize the booking in the DB and generate a QR ticket.

error_handling.slot_taken: Suggest next available slot or alternative date.
error_handling.api_timeout: Notify user of temporary delay and offer to call them back.
